subject.name: Image Processing and Pattern Recognition
subject.title: CB-803 (C) - Image Processing and Pattern Recognition

modules.title: Introduction: Image processing systems and its applications
topics: Image formation: Geometric and photometric models
Image definition and its representation, neighbourhood metrics.

modules.title: Unit 2
topics: Intensity transformations and spatial filtering: Enhancement, contrast stretching, histogram specification, local contrast enhancement
Smoothing, linear and order statistic filtering, sharpening, spatial convolution

modules.title: Unit 3
topics: Derivative based edge detection operators, edge detection/linking
Region growing, split/merge techniques, line detection

modules.title: Unit 4
topics: Image/Object features extraction: Textural features - gray level co-occurrence matrix
Distance transform, medial axis transform, skeletonization/thinning, shape properties.

modules.title: Unit 5
topics: Transform and similarity measures for registration
Colour image processing: Fundamentals of different colour models - RGB, CMY, HSI, YCbCr
Morphological Filtering Basics: Dilation and Erosion Operators
